title: Grateful Dead Live at Betty Nelson's Organic Raspberry Farm on 1968-09-02
lineage: SBD > Reel > DAT > ZA2 > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: A stellar 1968 performance with a smoking Dark Star and an epic 69‑minute Eleven, but the Volkerding soundboard tape suffers from mix imbalances, buzz and occasional clipping.
ai_review.review: The show is praised as a high‑energy continuation of the August ’68 concerts, featuring standout renditions of Dark Star, St. Stephen and a marathon The Eleven that many fans call timeless.  The Volkerding soundboard source is listenable but marred by a weak mix (Bob’s vocals and Phil’s bass are often buried), noticeable buzz and occasional clipping.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate the performance very highly (5‑star) while noting consistent recording flaws; weighting show quality heavily yields a strong overall rating despite technical issues.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mix is unbalanced – Bob’s guitar/vocals and Phil’s bass are low in the mix; some buzz and clipping present, but overall audible and comparable to other 1968 tapes.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Follows the high‑energy, fast‑paced setlists of the August shows with strong transitions and sustained momentum.

band_member_comments.Phil: Mix down makes his bass barely audible, though his playing is noted as strong in the performance.
band_member_comments.Bob: Vocals and rhythm guitar are often buried in the mix, reducing their presence.
